RE: Tacos el Sinaloa My Compita Mobile Application# PR7946
On this date, a pre-operational inspection was performed for the above facility. The following deficiencies and notes were made during the inspection:

NOT APPROVED TO OPERATE | NOT OKAY FOR CO
Correct the following deficiencies before the next inspection:
1.	The freshwater tank is installed on the roof of the unit and is open to contamination. Relocate the intake inside the unit, with exterior access for the freshwater hookup. Install a screen and cover over the exterior opening to protect against contamination.
2.	Secure the left cold-top refrigerator to the unit. 
3.	Seal all holes in the interior walls and ceiling with silicone to create smooth, easily cleanable surfaces.
4.	Label the three compartments of the three-compartment sink "Wash," "Rinse," and "Sanitize."
5.	The wastewater tank shutoff valve was not functioning properly. Repair or replace the valve to prevent wastewater from leaking outside the unit.

Follow-up required. 
Not approved to operate. Written approval from this Department is required before operation can begin.
